text:
[Council File 24-0916; CD 15]
Joint Department of Water and Power and Los Angeles Harbor Department report relative to the annual report on power outages or power surges at the Port of Los Angeles.
(This item was referred to Energy and Environment Committee and Trade, Travel and Tourism Committee)
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No

summary: The Department of Water and Power and the Harbor Department submit their annual report on power outages and power surges at the Port of Los Angeles.
